bounded_flow: The existing settings view keeps its local 541 draft on a same-profile native refresh, clears old metrics before held real reads after an authenticated actor switch in the same account, and displays the current server-authorized counts or unknown state.
fixture_refresh_boundary: Test-only callback reads real Account/Profile APIs and commits their actual native DTOs using the existing fixture store. It accepts no forged profile/permission object. Production has no such hook.
